people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: “The children of Israel shall encamp every man by his own standard, with the banners of their fathers’ houses. They shall encamp around the Tent of Meeting at a distance from it.”
translations.bsb: “The Israelites are to camp around the Tent of Meeting at a distance from it, each man under his standard, with the banners of his family.
translations.kjv: Every man of the children of Israel shall pitch by his own standard, with the ensign of their father's house: far off about the tabernacle of the congregation shall they pitch.
translations.asv: The children of Israel shall encamp every man by his own standard, with the ensigns of their fathers' houses: over against the tent of meeting shall they encamp round about.
